rules.title: Limit on payments required at or before start of tenancy
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or the lessor's agent may not require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay more than first month's rent, last month's rent at the same rate, a security deposit equal to the first month's rent, and the purchase and installation cost for a key and lock.
rules.key_value: first month's rent + last month's rent + security deposit equal to first month's rent + key and lock cost
rules.coverage_text: Tenants and prospective tenants of residential tenancies; applies to lessors and agents of the lessor.
rules.citation: General Laws Chapter 186, Section 15B(1)(b), as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:

rules.title: Security deposit maximum
rules.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed the first month's rent, and is allowed only if it is deposited as required by subsection (3) and the tenant is given the statement of condition required by subsection (2).
rules.key_value: equal to the first month's rent
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2);

rules.title: Fee in lieu of security deposit
rules.requirement: The executive office of housing and livable communities may authorize by regulation an optional fee in lieu of a security deposit; total fees and any security deposit paid may not exceed 1 month's rent, and the tenant must be allowed to pay a full security deposit instead.
rules.key_value: fees plus security deposit not to exceed 1 month's rent
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and tenants or prospective tenants who agree to a fee in lieu of a security deposit under regulations of the executive office.
rules.quoted_span: provided further, that the sum of fees paid to waive a security deposit and the payment of the security deposit shall not exceed, in total, the amount of 1 month's rent;

rules.title: No excess advance rent or deposit during tenancy
rules.requirement: After a tenancy begins, a lessor or successor in interest may not demand rent in advance beyond the current month's rent or a security deposit above the amount allowed by the section.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors and successors in interest of residential tenancies.
rules.quoted_span: No lessor or successor in interest shall at any time subsequent to the commencement of a tenancy demand rent in advance in excess of the current month's rent or a security deposit in excess of the amount allowed by this section.

rules.title: Last month's rent receipt and interest
rules.requirement: A lessor who collects last month's rent in advance must give a receipt with specified information and pay interest at five per cent per year or the lesser amount received from the bank, paid yearly and within thirty days of termination.
rules.key_value: five per cent (5%) per year or such lesser amount of interest as received from the bank
rules.coverage_text: Lessors or agents who receive rent in advance for the last month of a tenancy.
rules.exemptions: Interest does not accrue for the last month for which rent was paid in advance.
rules.penalty: If the lessor fails to pay interest within thirty days after termination, the tenant shall be awarded damages equal to three times the interest owed, plus court costs and reasonable attorneys fees; the tenant may also deduct unpaid annual interest from the next rent payment.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor or his agent who receives said rent in advance for the last month of tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held.

rules.title: Security deposit receipt
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent who receives a security deposit must give a signed receipt stating the amount, the recipient, the lessor's name if an agent receives it, the date and a description of the premises.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors or agents who receive a security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: (b) Any lessor or his agent who receives a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall give said tenant or prospective tenant at the time of receiving such security deposit a receipt indicating the amount of such security deposit, the name of the person receiving it and, in the case of an agent, the name of the lessor for whom such security deposit is received, the date on which it is received, and a description of the premises leased or rented.

rules.title: Statement of condition
rules.requirement: A lessor accepting a security deposit must, on receipt of the deposit or within ten days after the tenancy begins, whichever is later, give a signed written statement of the premises' condition listing existing damage, with the required notice; the lessor must respond within fifteen days to any tenant damage list.
rules.key_value: within ten days after commencement of the tenancy
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property or agents who accept a security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Security deposit records
rules.requirement: A lessor accepting security deposits must keep records of damage, termination dates, repairs and receipts, make them available to tenants on request during business hours, and keep them for two years after the tenancy ends.
rules.key_value: two years from termination of the tenancy
rules.coverage_text: Lessors who accept a security deposit.
rules.penalty: On wrongful failure to make the record available for inspection, the tenant is entitled to immediate return of the security deposit with accrued interest.
rules.quoted_span: Every lessor who accepts a security deposit shall maintain a record of all such security deposits received which contains the following information:--

rules.title: Separate interest-bearing account and bank receipt
rules.requirement: A security deposit must be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a Massachusetts bank, protected from the lessor's creditors and not commingled, and the tenant must get a receipt with the bank name, location, amount and account number within thirty days.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors who receive a security deposit.
rules.penalty: Failure to comply entitles the tenant to immediate return of the security deposit; a lessor who fails to deposit the funds as required forfeits the right to retain any portion of the deposit.
rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.

rules.title: Interest on security deposit
rules.requirement: A lessor holding a security deposit for one year or longer must pay interest at five per cent per year, or the lesser amount received from the bank, at the end of each year with an annual statement; if unpaid thirty days after year end, the tenant may deduct it from rent.
rules.key_value: five per cent (5%) per year or such lesser amount of interest as received from the bank
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential real property holding a security deposit for one year or longer from the start of the tenancy.
rules.penalty: If the tenant has not received the interest or notice within thirty days after the end of each tenancy year, the tenant may deduct the interest due from the next rent payment.
rules.quoted_span: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Return of security deposit and allowed deductions
rules.requirement: The lessor must return the security deposit or balance within thirty days after the tenancy ends, deducting only unpaid rent or water charges, unpaid tax escalation increases, and reasonable repair costs for tenant-caused damage beyond reasonable wear and tear, with a sworn itemized list and written cost evidence.
rules.exemptions: No deduction for damage listed in the statement of condition or tenant's signed damage list unless later repaired and the new damage is unrelated; reasonable wear and tear excluded.
rules.penalty: The lessor forfeits the right to retain any portion of the deposit or to counterclaim for damage if he fails to furnish the itemized list of damages within thirty days or fails to return the deposit or balance with interest within thirty days after termination.
rules.quoted_span: The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;

rules.title: Transfer of security deposit to successor in interest
rules.requirement: A lessor who transfers his interest must transfer the security deposit and accrued interest to the successor, who becomes liable for it and must notify the tenant in writing within forty-five days.
rules.key_value: notice within forty-five days of transfer
rules.coverage_text: Lessors who transfer their interest in a dwelling unit for which a security deposit is held, and their successors in interest.
rules.exemptions: Granting a mortgage is not a transfer of interest; successor liability for an untransferred deposit does not apply to a city or town acquiring title under chapter sixty or to a foreclosing mortgagee or mortgagee in possession that is a financial institution chartered by the commonwealth or the United States.
rules.penalty: A lessor who fails to transfer the deposit or comply with subsection (5) forfeits the right to retain any portion of the security deposit.
rules.quoted_span: the lessor shall transfer such security deposit together with any interest which has accrued thereon for the benefit of the tenant who made such security deposit to his successor in interest, and said successor in interest shall be liable for the retention and return of said security deposit in accordance with the provisions of this section from the date upon which said transfer is made;
